decisions.what: Used dot notation for process.env access in environment.ts
decisions.why: Root tsconfig.json enables strict but not noUncheckedIndexedAccess, so dot notation is safe and idiomatic.

decisions.what: Prefixed unused Express handler parameters with underscore
decisions.why: tsconfig has noUnusedParameters:true; underscore prefix satisfies the compiler while preserving the Express middleware signatures.

decisions.what: Used .js suffix on relative TypeScript imports
decisions.why: backend tsconfig sets module and moduleResolution to NodeNext with package.json type: module, which requires explicit .js extensions on relative specifiers.

decisions.what: Added port range validation in the config loader
decisions.why: The spec requires loading and validating environment variables; rejecting out-of-range PORT values gives an actionable error at startup rather than at bind time.

decisions.what: Only exposed err.stack in the error response when NODE_ENV is development
decisions.why: Matches the spec's explicit requirement to include stack traces only in development.
